$comment: Banned v3 vocabulary (docs/01-glossary.md). 'words' is a lowercase word sequence; identifiers (camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case) are split into words before matching, so 'ToolConfigSchema' hits 'tool config'. A trailing s is accepted; a trailing * means any word starting with it. Changing this list needs the owner. 'allow' lists legitimate uses as { file (path prefix), words, reason }.
